about: Draft disclosures for the Official entries, written by hand from each entry's code at writtenFrom. omega_hub_import_official --fill-missing puts one in a manifest that has no disclosure; the approving maintainer still confirms or rewrites it in review (SPEC 5.4, decision 20). codeSha256 is omega_hub/official_seed.py's fingerprint of the files the text describes: when they change, the import refuses the entry until the text is checked again.
